task.original_request: Using only the supplied architecture facts, explain the two OTP restart strategies. Supplied facts: one_for_one restarts only the failed child; rest_for_one restarts the failed child and the children started after it.
task.child_objective: Distinguish one_for_one from rest_for_one without changing which children each strategy restarts.
task.expected_result: A brief, factual distinction that preserves the supplied restart scope and makes no availability guarantee.

scenarios.draft: one_for_one restarts every child in the supervisor, while rest_for_one restarts only the child that failed.

task.original_request: Using only the supplied recovery contract, describe replay. Supplied contract: the append-only log can redeliver an event; idempotent handlers make repeated application safe; the contract does not guarantee exactly-once delivery.
task.child_objective: Explain how replay supports recovery without strengthening the delivery guarantee.
task.expected_result: A brief explanation that preserves possible redelivery, idempotency, and the absence of an exactly-once guarantee.

scenarios.draft: The append-only log guarantees exactly-once replay, so each event is applied once after a crash.

task.original_request: Read the supplied rollout record. Supplied record: owner=Team Blue; rollback_threshold is not present.
task.child_objective: Return both the exact rollout owner and the exact rollback threshold from the supplied record.
task.expected_result: The child result is complete only if both exact supplied values are available. Do not infer, estimate, or invent the missing threshold; leave the task unresolved when it cannot be supplied.

scenarios.draft: The rollout owner is Team Blue.

task.original_request: Summarize the supplied maintenance datum. Supplied datum: maintenance starts at 09:00 UTC on 2026-09-01 and applies only to read replicas.
task.child_objective: Paraphrase the maintenance start and scope in one sentence.
task.expected_result: Preserve that the time is a start boundary and that the scope is limited to read replicas.

scenarios.draft: Maintenance begins at 09:00 UTC on 2026-09-01 and is limited to read replicas.

task.original_request: Compare only the supplied garden-light observations. Supplied observations: the mint container receives four hours of morning sun; the basil bed receives seven hours of sun. No yield result is supplied.
task.child_objective: Compare the two locations' supplied light exposure without predicting plant yield.
task.expected_result: A brief comparison of the two supplied durations with no unsupported yield guarantee.
